Author: CoelZzz
Name: Raid Helper
Description:
Shows a compact helper window with live mechanic calls for supported fights.

Dancing Mad (Ultimate): P1 rings, gazes, rocks and cleaves; P2 Forsaken and Trine; P3 Black Hole and hand attacks; P4 debuffs; P5 Chaotic Flood.

The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate): P2 nisi lineup; P3 Wormhole; P4 Fate Calibration Alpha and Beta.
Punchline: Mechanic calls for high-end raids, one fight at a time.
Changelog: TEA: client raise countdowns for Temporal Stasis and Inception; the Inception Shared Sentence stack call (who stacks with the MT); a role helper for PLD, MCH and casters (P1-P3 cooldown plan, P1 directions from the middle tornado, P2 movement with nisi passes, Water/Lightning, Enumeration and the ice drop). The preview tabs now scroll sideways when they don't fit.
